Seedance Prompt Builder 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Build, rewrite, audit, and troubleshoot prompts for Doubao Seedance 2.0 video generation and editing.
- Supports multimodal assets: text-to-video, image, video, and audio references.
- Covers prompt routing, subject labeling, shot sequencing, and style constraints.
- Includes structure and best practices for professional, quick, storyboard, and audit modes.
- Provides guidance on quality, stability, and common failure fixes specific to Seedance.
